# Zehn

> Zehn is a book summary app for iPhone and Android. It has 10,000+ nonfiction books as 15–30 minute audio and text summaries with synced text, and Ask AI, a chat on every book that answers questions about that book. Summaries are available in English, Russian, Arabic, Tajik, Hindi and Urdu.

Zehn (pronounced "Zen") is made by Safari Group. Compared with Blinkist and Headway, it is built for non-English readers and adds AI chat per book.

## App

- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6759160035): Zehn for iPhone and iPad
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.audiobook.zehn): Zehn for Android

## Book summary catalogs

- [All books](https://thezehnapp.com/books/): every summary, filter by language and category
- [English book summaries](https://thezehnapp.com/en/books/): 834 summaries by category
- [Russian book summaries](https://thezehnapp.com/ru/books/): 737 summaries by category
- [Arabic book summaries](https://thezehnapp.com/ar/books/): 788 summaries by category
- [Tajik book summaries](https://thezehnapp.com/tg/books/): 37 summaries by category
- [Urdu book summaries](https://thezehnapp.com/urdu/books/): 2 summaries by category
